anya: quick follow-up from the quantization RFC meeting — I want to capture the runtime migration / compatibility concerns now that we might push FP8 + int8 + 4-bit lanes in parallel. main Q: how do we swap precision profiles without blowing up in-flight chats or incurring huge migration costs? :thinking:

sam: agreed this is the gnarly bit. my brain: per-route "precision policy" + per-request negotiation header (eg `x-precision-preference`). but the KV cache formats differ so we need a translation or drain approach. translation might be expensive.

jf: +1. if we standardize an on-disk, versioned profile format (protobuf), we can ship a small compatibility shim that can convert prefixes lazily. makes rolling upgrades cheaper because we only translate active prefixes.

laura: important: we need hard quality gates. even if perf looks good, FP8 can introduce odd hallucination regression for some prompts. propose automated eval suite and an alert when quality delta > 0.02 BLEU-like or whatever metric we choose on the canary slice.

mike: ops note: translation-on-the-fly is CPU-heavy. if we do lazy conversion we still spike CPU during the first hour of rollout. suggest canary traffic windows and a cost-budget alert. also we should add a route-level throttle for conversions.

ria: runtime idea: keep old worker handling existing KV caches, spin up new workers with new quant. route new requests to new workers, drain old ones. problem: long-lived chat sessions pinned to sessions -> sticky routing needed. we can implement a prefix-bridge layer that accepts requests for pinned sessions and proxies to the correct worker while gradually migrating the cached prefixes.

sam: example route policy sketch (very rough):
```
precision_policy: 
  default: fp8
  fallbacks: [int8, 4bit]
  canary: 5%
  metric_thresholds:
    quality_delta: 0.015
    latency_p95: 50ms
```
this will let console and runtime coordinate.

anya: what telemetry events do we need to know this is safe? my wishlist: `precision.migration.start`, `.prefix_translated`, `.fallback.triggered`, `.quality.regression` with model + endpoint tags and sample ids.

ops-bot: canary-deploy job queued: deploy/canary-precision-profile-2026-03-20 (#3456). ETA 02:00 UTC.

jf: small storage/format note: profiles should include `compatible_with` array to enumerate older profile versions. translation tooling should be idempotent and reversible for 24h rollback window. also add checksum to detect accidental mismatch.

laura: action items I care about: 1) add the eval tests and threshold to the RFC follow-up doc, 2) define sticky-routing behavior for chat sessions, 3) owner for migration tool (ops + infra). i'll draft tasks in GH after standup.

mike: ack, i'll add an ops playbook entry: cost-alerting + throttles + emergency rollback route.

anya: great. next sync: quick tech-check before we queue canary. i'll open the RFC follow-up PR with the policy sketch and telemetry fields. :thumbsup:
